result.summary: Re-read lib/letflow/design/req059-pin-resolver.md in full, independently, post-rework commit 6e35ea9. Both prior findings verified fixed, not merely claimed fixed. (1) Section 3 (now titled 'the exact reordering') is a 7-step numbered prose specification -- each step names the existing/new function called, its inputs (already in scope), and its {:ok, ...}/error-shape contract, plus prose stating the with-chain short-circuit discipline by reference rather than by literal with/case syntax. Ran `grep -nE '^\s*(def|defp|case .* do$|with .* <-)'` across the whole 637-line file myself: the only match is the pre-existing, previously-approved `defmodule Letflow.Engine.PinResolver.Lookup do` / `defstruct [...]` block (lines 239/241) -- a bare field-list struct definition (schema/type shape, no logic), which was already the correct precedent in the prior FAIL verdict and is unchanged. Zero function bodies, zero with-chains, zero case statements anywhere in the document. (2) New section 12 ('PIN-03 AC4 -- exhausted retry budget, named hook') is a genuine design element, not a deferral: states no retry loop/budget/DLQ exists in this module, reserves the concrete event-type name PIN_RETRY_EXHAUSTED as the documented S6 DLQ attachment point, cites REQ-056's identical gap and the ServiceScopeValidator/PromotionPlan/dispatch_exclusive_gateway/4 SCOPE-GAP-naming precedent already used correctly elsewhere in this doc, adds moduledoc item 7 (section 2) requiring this be stated, and adds a PIN-03 AC4 row to section 10's AC-to-design-element map. This matches REQ-059's own requirement text ('leave a named hook rather than a partial DLQ') exactly -- covered, not gapped. No regressions found elsewhere: section 4's resolve/4 @spec now reads `{:ok, [pinned_version()], variable_json_schema :: map() | nil} | resolve_error()` (3-tuple), matching section 5's INV-PIN-5 explanation which previously referenced a 2-tuple/section-3-pseudocode inconsistency; section 5's stray 'section 3's pseudocode is corrected accordingly' sentence now reads 'section 3's step 2/3 sequence above already reflects this' -- consistent with section 3 no longer being pseudocode. Diffed 98a464b..6e35ea9 directly: only section 3, section 4's @spec line, section 5's one sentence, section 2's new moduledoc item 7, and the new section 12 changed; sections 1, 6, 7, 8, 9 (all six open questions), and 11 are byte-identical to the version already independently verified correct in the prior PASS-eligible findings. No new TBD/deferral language introduced, no cross-module dependency list changed, no new implementation code anywhere.
